style_authority.note: Resolves the adaptive product context while keeping shared content and semantic roles distinct from platform-native navigation, controls, materials, motion, and layout.

reference_selection.note: Applies product, iOS, Android, adaptive layout, accessibility, interaction-physics, motion, design-system, source-audit, and runtime-validation guidance.

anti_generic_redesign.note: Repairs native trust, task recovery, accessibility, adaptive structure, controls, theming, and motion without decorative generic styling.

evidence_level.note: Labels the review static prompt-only and explicitly denies source, build, screenshot, accessibility-tree, Simulator, Emulator, device, and performance evidence.

verified_boundary.note: Confines verified facts to the supplied description and lists unknown hit regions, accessibility, contrast, gestures, window behavior, recovery, performance, and hardware evidence.

design_moves.note: Provides eight concrete moves spanning adaptive layouts, native navigation, target sizes, scalable type, platform controls, semantic tokens, accessible motion, width-aware navigation, and parity.

scope_control.note: Uses 111 logical lines, exactly five blockers and eight moves, and stays within native UI conformance and decisive source, build, Simulator, Emulator, and real-device validation.
